conditions_would_cease: If a generic exact reader is proven to satisfy H/S/Q/O for all six envelopes at required scale.
finding: Canonical body preservation is necessary but not sufficient: the selected access architecture must expose respondent-major events and question-major selector/denominator views plus derived-product manifests. The R2 machine fields described storage, not the full access contract.
negative_witness: Prepared-only path helps repeated S but leaves fresh-open S, full Q and O; no explicit question-major selector contract.
question: Does preserving the 13-family canonical body also preserve the downstream access capabilities?
reuse_beyond_anvil: General lesson: canonical storage and capability access are separate architecture layers.
strongest_counterargument: A generic body reader plus native evaluator may be sufficient; access views could be implementation detail.
uncertainty: No measured 100k access run; view implementation not built.

conditions_would_cease: A measured workload shows prepared reuse improves fresh opens or removes Q/O.
finding: Prepared reuse removes repeated session index build S within one process; it does not remove fresh-open S, per-operation scientific counting Q or evidence output O.
negative_witness: Four-op report is not a 100-op measurement; no fresh-process benefit; C found exact-type Batch rejection.
question: What exactly does PreparedI03Session remove?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable cost-layer distinction H/S/Q/O for any repeated-query system.
strongest_counterargument: The 1.69-1.70x author report could indicate wider gains.
uncertainty: S share vs Q/O is unmeasured; four-op basis hypothetical.

conditions_would_cease: Never for a true k>=3 joint claim.
finding: No. Even/odd parity witnesses have identical univariate and pairwise marginals but different P(111) and disjoint triple support. F4 must consume true same-person rows, not a pairwise product.
negative_witness: Even parity 000,011,101,110 vs odd 001,010,100,111: same marginals, P(111)=0 vs 1/4.
question: Do pairwise marginals determine a same-person k>=3 joint?
reuse_beyond_anvil: General statistical caution: marginal equality does not imply joint equality.
strongest_counterargument: Pairwise approximations may suffice for some exploratory summaries.
uncertainty: Real source sparsity/minority support may be small; exact joint still required where claimed.

conditions_would_cease: Only under an explicitly authorized symmetric estimand with identical eligible populations.
finding: F2 forward P(Y|D) and reverse P(D|Y) use different eligible/asked/observed bases; one denominator or algebraic inversion is wrong. Typed NOT_ASKED/routing-unknown cannot be zero.
negative_witness: Same question pair with different routing/asked bases yields different denominators; reuse would misstate one direction.
question: Are forward and reverse F2 denominators interchangeable?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable denominator discipline for conditional survey analysis.
strongest_counterargument: Symmetric conditioning may be acceptable for a descriptive shortcut.
uncertainty: Real source routing patterns vary; exact evaluator remains authority.

conditions_would_cease: If a source actually releases a valid individual field with provenance and permission.
finding: Never automatically. OBSERVED_RESPONDENT, SAMPLE_DESIGN_ONLY, COLLECTED_BUT_NOT_RELEASED, EXTERNAL_GROUP_CONTEXT, PROXY_OBSERVED, MEASUREMENT_NONCOMPARABLE and RIGHTS_HELD are distinct. AB II strata are not released individual sect; Latinobarometro religion/race is not Lebanese ancestry.
negative_witness: External group estimate attached to a respondent; party/geography relabeled sect; unreleased field treated as observed.
question: When may a sample-design stratum or proxy become respondent identity?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable source-observability taxonomy for survey-based research.
strongest_counterargument: A strong group proxy may be useful for descriptive group context.
uncertainty: Actual wave field availability varies by source and release.

conditions_would_cease: A qualified F6 method/owner product with exact intervals and N9 reader.
finding: No. The guard returns admission/refusal and support/uncertainty material; effective N is F018. No dedicated numeric F6 interval/uncovered-mass method was found. F6 numeric remains an external owner-held derived product.
negative_witness: Calling I07 PASS an F6 numeric bound; omitting uncovered mass.
question: Is the I07/I04 structural guard the F6 numeric partial-identification interval?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable distinction between structural compatibility and numeric partial identification.
strongest_counterargument: The guard might be used as a conservative structural precondition.
uncertainty: An external F6 method may exist outside this product cut.

conditions_would_cease: A qualified overlap/panel or comparability authority establishes the specific comparison.
finding: No. Cross-sections are not longitudinal selves; wave time, instrument, population and source must be separate. F7 needs a separately issued comparability index and nonpooling/refusal; no pseudo-person join.
negative_witness: Adult 2010 response used as child 1995 history; same name pooled across incomparable instruments.
question: Does a same-name variable across waves establish individual temporal change?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable time/observability caution for cross-wave research.
strongest_counterargument: Repeated cross-sections can support aggregate trend claims under strong assumptions.
uncertainty: Some waves may have genuine comparable items; owner audit required.

conditions_would_cease: A separately authorized causal/structural source and rule actually establishes power.
finding: No. FF01 is a conditional association/profile with producer permission ceiling; FF02 requires independent institutional/material evidence, population/time/rule. Survey frequency or group majority is not coercive power.
negative_witness: Majority opinion labeled institutional power; group label given resources.
question: Does observed FF01 association become FF02 material power?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable descriptive-versus-structural firewall.
strongest_counterargument: FF01 associations may motivate an FF02 hypothesis.
uncertainty: Specific structural sources and joins remain owner-held.

conditions_would_cease: A qualified encounter/access source and world owner actually consumes it.
finding: No. Different other-position configurations may change potential Other candidates, but actual encounter/contact/kinship requires a separate relational source. Availability is not access; access is not comprehension; comprehension is not identification; identification is not action.
negative_witness: Marginals turned into marriage/contact probability; offscreen event becomes actor knowledge.
question: Do position marginals establish actual encounter/relationship?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable availability/access/action separation for social simulation.
strongest_counterargument: A model may propose a bounded fictional relation under explicit model grade.
uncertainty: Encounter datasets are sparse and owner-held.

conditions_would_cease: A separately authorized actor development rule and actual first reader.
finding: No. N9/N10W produce objective/world-conditioned possibility; SOROK HistoricalWorld is a separate actor reader with access/consent/history. A survey vector is not a person and an objective world is not a psyche.
negative_witness: N9 option copied into actor private knowledge; survey response used as motive.
question: Is objective N9 world the same as a SOROK person?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable world-versus-actor separation.
strongest_counterargument: A sourcefree world can be used as a test harness for a possible actor.
uncertainty: Actual SOROK first reader unproved; owner-held.

conditions_would_cease: A selected J/FF owner proof at exact scope.
finding: No. J role/component certification and M1/M2 composition provide a scoped manifest path; review-only is not certified ALLOW; the FF consumer must use the true source/scope. Selected J->FF first reader remains owner-held.
negative_witness: J output manifest consumed at wrong scope; review-only treated as certified.
question: Does a J-to-FF manifest imply a certified FF effect?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable manifest-scope discipline for staged analytical handoffs.
strongest_counterargument: The code path may be sufficient for a narrow test.
uncertainty: No selected J->FF native first reader in this pass.

conditions_would_cease: An owner-qualified structural sign source/field is issued.
finding: Not found as a standalone canonical family/field. Source projection/admission carries value/role/authority; signed/nonneutral meaning is an FF02 structural-owner issuance. Neutral0 is not missing and nonneutral is not causal power.
negative_witness: Neutral0 treated as absence; sign inferred from a label; power inferred from sign.
question: Is signed neutral/nonneutral a standalone canonical C11 field?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable distinction between source value and structural sign.
strongest_counterargument: A derived typed atom could be stored later.
uncertainty: R157 projection field availability varies by source.

conditions_would_cease: A full family/selector direct proof from source to physical bytes without journal origin.
finding: No. A journal-derived Q2 would undermine independent source comparison. Q2 must originate from the source-derived typed stream; the journal is transport/parity only. If independence is not proved for every family/selector, keep the second certificate.
negative_witness: Source/journals diverge silently; producer-only hash agreement accepted.
question: Can a Q2 certificate be built from the re-parsed JSONL transport journal?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable source-vs-transport independence rule.
strongest_counterargument: The journal is byte-exact and hash-checked, so re-parsing may be equivalent.
uncertainty: No one-certificate implementation in this pass.

conditions_would_cease: Measured S material and compact exact index passes proof/retention.
finding: No. The cited SQLite index is 1.30GB, about 4.19x the 310.16MB estate; invalidation/rebuild and compact exact encoding are unproven. It is the only route to remove fresh S, but must pass H/S/Q/O and retained-size/binding gates.
negative_witness: Stale index served after revocation; retained cost ignored.
question: Does a durable locator index automatically earn its retained cost?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable TCO test for derived indexes.
strongest_counterargument: A compact exact encoding could be far smaller.
uncertainty: No real-width measurement; compact encoding unbuilt.

conditions_would_cease: A measured compact encoding preserves exact identity/replay.
finding: No. Two hundred thousand refs at 150-250 bytes is 30-50MB per fact before provenance; 100 facts is 3-5GB. Exact content-addressed set refs may be shared only under identical population/condition/routing/measure/wave; replay re-executes; cached facts never authoritative.
negative_witness: Shared denominator across F2 directions; cached fact after revocation.
question: Is per-fact evidence output cheap at 100k?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable evidence-output amplification warning.
strongest_counterargument: Compression/reference dictionaries could reduce bytes.
uncertainty: Actual serialization/cardinality unmeasured.

conditions_would_cease: An owner-approved adapter proves one _build/four ops through actual Batch.
finding: No. Exact type(admission) is SavedC11Admission rejects PreparedSavedC11Admission; Batch saved_mode has the same exact-type guard. Relaxing type alone would still open fresh sessions. Owner-approved prepared-mode adapter is required; wrapper/Batch remains PROPOSED_NOT_WIRED.
negative_witness: C ABI witness: execute_saved_i03 and BatchExecutionRunner reject prepared subclass, 2 passed.
question: Does the named Batch/first-consumer path accept the prepared admission?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable lesson: inheritance is not wiring; exact type guards protect authority.
strongest_counterargument: Subclass should be accepted by normal polymorphism.
uncertainty: No owner-approved adapter implemented.

conditions_would_cease: A concrete route is shown for each consequential row.
finding: No. The four K1 rows have distinct required information/consumer routes. R3 provides specific routes: signed atom/admission + FF02 hold; F6 numeric separate owner product; N9/SOROK separation; J/FF manifest scope.
negative_witness: Same generic fate repeated for four different obligations.
question: Are generic crosswalk fates sufficient for K1-CAP-08/17/23/27?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable auditing rule: an ID is not an accommodation argument.
strongest_counterargument: The surrounding graph may already supply the specificity.
uncertainty: No exhaustive 141-row recensus; source-lineage sampled.

conditions_would_cease: Never; a structural guard cannot by itself establish science.
finding: No. The guard checks documentary/structural completeness only. It does not prove semantic truth, native execution, source rights, 100k/6GiB economics or whole downstream accommodation.
negative_witness: C explicitly accepted only the conditional direction; source-lineage sampled.
question: Does the 20/118 structural guard prove scientific accommodation?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable distinction between guard completeness and scientific/epistemic truth.
strongest_counterargument: A PASS is useful release hygiene.
uncertainty: No independent whole-accommodation C yet.

conditions_would_cease: Never; source authorization remains separate.
finding: No. Native evaluator code executes on sourcefree fixtures; sourcefree is a source-rights/authority label, not an execution impossibility. It is also not native source proof.
negative_witness: Calling a sourcefree native-evaluator PASS native source/science acceptance.
question: Does sourcefree mean the native evaluator cannot execute?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable proof-grade vocabulary.
strongest_counterargument: Sourcefree tests may not exercise real source shapes.
uncertainty: Real source/routing/weight shapes differ.

conditions_would_cease: A filesystem-specific proven no-replace operation plus crash injection.
finding: No. rename can replace an existing target on some systems. Use a proven no-clobber claim/lease, private stage, manifest-linked completion, typed orphan; do not claim a portable atomic rename guarantee. Crash-injection proof remains.
negative_witness: Target-before-manifest crash leaves manifest-less orphan; rename could overwrite a rival.
question: Does atomic rename guarantee no-clobber portability?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable no-clobber/recovery caution for CAS publication.
strongest_counterargument: A single rename is simpler and atomic on POSIX for same filesystem.
uncertainty: No crash-injection run in R3.

conditions_would_cease: Measurement shows Q not dominant or exact candidate streams cannot be preserved.
finding: Potentially yes, if the views supply exact candidate streams to the existing evaluator and preserve all-universe risk/missing/routing/occurrence/weight semantics. A second evaluator is forbidden. The gain is unmeasured and depends on Q dominance.
negative_witness: A second evaluator or approximate candidate pruning would break exactness.
question: Can demand-driven typed views reduce selector work without a second evaluator?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable candidate-stream vs evaluator separation.
strongest_counterargument: The current all-respondent loop may be cheap relative to I/O/output.
uncertainty: No measured Q share; no view implementation.

conditions_would_cease: A competent owner adopts a specific scientific/actor rule.
finding: They are documentary reverse-consumer demands, not scientific issuers, adopted causal law, new C11 layout or actor authorization. Useful as design constraints and research questions; not proof of FF02/N9/SOROK.
negative_witness: Citing a reverse report as source/actor acceptance.
question: Are SEAM/26 and ANVIL/15 adopted science or design constraints?
reuse_beyond_anvil: Reusable research-status discipline.
strongest_counterargument: Their detailed requirements could be treated as a de facto spec.
uncertainty: Owner receiving separate.
